literal: beacon · fire · play tricks on · the feudal lords
natural: toying with the lords by lighting the beacons

meaning.en: King You of Zhou lit the warning beacons to amuse his favourite; abusing trust for a whim, so that nobody believes you when it counts.
meaning.zh: 周幽王为博褒姒一笑，点燃烽火欺骗诸侯；比喻拿信用开玩笑，失信于人。

examples.zh: 他一再编造谎言，已是烽火戏诸侯，没人再信他了。
examples.en: He keeps inventing lies, like lighting the beacons for fun, and no one believes him any more.

examples.zh: 烽火戏诸侯的故事提醒我们：信用一旦用完就很难挽回。
examples.en: The story of the beacon fires reminds us that credit once spent is hard to win back.

story.en: King You lit the beacons to please Bao Si; when real invaders came, the lords no longer responded and he was killed at Mount Li.
story.zh: 周幽王为博褒姒一笑，数次举烽火戏弄诸侯；犬戎来攻时诸侯不至，幽王被杀于骊山下。

usage.en: The story: King You lit the beacons so that the lords rushed to the capital, and his queen Bao Si laughed at them. When Quanrong invaders really came, nobody came to help and the Western Zhou ended in 771 BC. Used as a warning against crying wolf; historically doubtful but famous.
usage.zh: 故事：周幽王点燃烽火，诸侯赶来，褒姒见而大笑；后来犬戎真的入侵，烽火无人理会，西周灭亡。多用来警告“狼来了”式的失信。史实有争议，但流传甚广。

natural: Yue Fei's mother tattoos his back

meaning.en: Yue Fei's mother tattooed words of loyalty on his back (in the popular tradition, 'serve the country with utmost loyalty'); a mother's teaching of patriotism.
meaning.zh: 岳飞之母在他背上刺下“精忠报国”四字；指母亲教子爱国。

examples.zh: 岳母刺字的故事教育了一代又一代中国孩子。
examples.en: The story of Yue Fei's mother has taught generations of Chinese children.

examples.zh: 妈妈给我讲了岳母刺字的故事，让我懂得做人要忠诚。
examples.en: Mum told me the story of Yue Fei's mother, which taught me to be loyal.

usage.en: The popular version, with 精忠报国 tattooed by his mother, comes from the novel 《说岳全传》; the 《宋史》 only says the characters read 尽忠报国. A staple of school textbooks and parenting talk.
usage.zh: 通行版本（母亲刺“精忠报国”）源自《说岳全传》；《宋史》记载为“尽忠报国”。常见于课文和家教话题。

story.en: In the Qing novel Shuo Yue Quanzhuan, Yue Fei's mother tattoos 'serve the country with utmost loyalty' on his back. The History of Song records only that the words were on his back and has no mother, so the story is fiction.
story.zh: 清代小说《说岳全传》写岳母在岳飞背上刺“精忠报国”；《宋史》只记其背有“尽忠报国”字，并无岳母刺字之事，故属小说演绎。

natural: Su Wu herds sheep

meaning.en: Su Wu, held captive by the Xiongnu, herded sheep for nineteen years without giving up his loyalty to the Han; steadfastness in hardship.
meaning.zh: 苏武被匈奴扣留，在北海牧羊十九年，始终不屈；形容在艰难中坚守气节。

examples.zh: 被困多年，他像苏武牧羊一样，从未放弃信念。
examples.en: Trapped for years, he never gave up his convictions, like Su Wu among his sheep.

examples.zh: 教科书里苏武牧羊的故事让我们懂得气节。
examples.en: The story of Su Wu and his sheep in the textbook teaches us integrity.

story.en: Su Wu was sent to the Xiongnu and held captive; refusing to surrender, he was exiled to Lake Baikal to herd rams and held the Han staff for nineteen years.
story.zh: 苏武出使匈奴被扣，拒不投降，被迁到北海牧羊，持汉节十九年。

usage.en: Su Wu was sent as an envoy to the Xiongnu in 100 BC, refused to surrender, and returned in 81 BC. A set image for national loyalty and endurance.
usage.zh: 苏武于公元前100年出使匈奴，被扣留，不肯投降，前81年才得归汉。是忠贞和坚忍的典型形象。

natural: Tian Ji's horse race

meaning.en: Sun Bin's plan for Tian Ji to beat the king: match each of your horses against a weaker one of his, losing one race but winning two; winning overall through clever allocation.
meaning.zh: 孙膑教田忌用下等马对上等马、上等马对中等马、中等马对下等马，三局两胜；比喻合理搭配资源以取胜。

equivalents: trade a loss for an overall win

examples.zh: 这场比赛我们采用田忌赛马的策略，先让主力休息。
examples.en: In this match we used the Tian Ji strategy, resting our main players first.

examples.zh: 经济学课上讲了田忌赛马，说明了博弈的道理。
examples.en: In economics class they explained Tian Ji's horse race to illustrate game theory.

story.en: Sun Bin advised Tian Ji to race his worst horse against the king's best, his best against the king's middle, and his middle against the king's worst, and Tian Ji won two out of three.
story.zh: 孙膑献计：以下驷对其上驷，取其上驷与彼中驷，取其中驷与彼下驷，田忌三战两胜。

usage.en: Today a favourite example in game theory, sports tactics and project management: give up the local to win the whole.
usage.zh: 如今常作博弈论、竞技战术和项目管理的例子：舍局部以取全局。

natural: steal the tally to save Zhao

meaning.en: Lord Xinling stole the Wei king's military tally to command an army and rescue the state of Zhao; helping a friend by taking a bold risk.
meaning.zh: 信陵君窃取魏王兵符，调兵救援赵国；比喻不惜冒险违规，救助他人于危难。

equivalents: break the rules to rescue an ally
bold rescue at great personal risk

examples.zh: 他不惜违规，窃符救赵，帮朋友渡过了难关。
examples.en: He broke the rules, like Lord Xinling stealing the tally, to see his friend through.

examples.zh: 历史课上老师讲了窃符救赵的故事。
examples.en: In history class the teacher told the story of the stolen tally.

story.en: Lord Xinling of Wei, with the help of the king's concubine Ru Ji, stole the tally, killed the general Jin Bi and led the army to relieve Handan in 257 BC.
story.zh: 信陵君借如姬之力窃得兵符，椎杀晋鄙，率军救邯郸之围。

usage.en: Positive when the motive is loyalty to a friend or ally. Literary; also the title of a Peking opera.
usage.zh: 出于义气时含褒义。书面语，也是京剧剧目名。

natural: Xiang Yu's suicide at the Wu River

meaning.en: Xiang Yu, beaten by Liu Bang, refused to cross the Wu River and killed himself; the tragic end of a proud hero.
meaning.zh: 项羽兵败垓下，不肯渡乌江，自刎而死；指英雄末路。

examples.zh: 项羽乌江自刎，成了千古悲剧英雄。
examples.en: Xiang Yu's suicide at the Wu River made him an eternal tragic hero.

examples.zh: 他读《项羽本纪》时，为乌江自刎的结局唏嘘不已。
examples.en: Reading the Basic Annals of Xiang Yu, he sighed over the ending of Xiang Yu cutting his own throat at the Wu River.

story.en: Xiang Yu declined the ferryman's offer at the Wu River, saying he was ashamed to face the elders of Jiangdong, and then took his own life.
story.zh: 乌江亭长劝项羽渡江，项羽说无面目见江东父老，遂自刎。

usage.en: Read zì wěn ('slit one's own throat'). Used for a proud person who chooses death over humiliation.
usage.zh: “刎”读 wěn。多指宁死不受辱的英雄末路。

pinyin: bù wèi wǔ dǒu mǐ zhé yāo
literal: not · for · five · dou · rice · bend · waist
natural: not bow for five pecks of rice

meaning.en: To refuse to humble oneself for a salary; keeping one's integrity before authority.
meaning.zh: 不为微薄的俸禄向人低头；比喻保持气节，不向权势屈服。

equivalents: refuse to bow for a pittance

examples.zh: 他宁愿辞职，也不为五斗米折腰。
examples.en: He would rather resign than bow and scrape for a pay cheque.

examples.zh: 陶渊明不为五斗米折腰，辞官归田。
examples.en: Tao Yuanming refused to bow for five pecks of rice and retired to the fields.

story.en: Tao Qian, magistrate of Pengze, refused to put on formal dress to meet an inspector, saying 'I cannot bend my waist to a village boy for five pecks of rice', and resigned.
story.zh: 陶潜任彭泽令，郡督邮来，吏请束带见之，潜叹曰：“吾不能为五斗米折腰向乡里小人邪！”即日解绶去职。

usage.en: The famous act of the poet Tao Yuanming, who quit as a county magistrate rather than greet a supervisor properly. Praise for independence; also said jokingly about a job one doesn't need.
usage.zh: 诗人陶渊明辞去彭泽县令的故事。赞扬人格独立，有时也用于戏谑。

natural: talent for chanting willow-catkins

meaning.en: A girl's literary talent, from Xie Daoyun's line comparing snow to willow catkins in the wind.
meaning.zh: 指女子的文学才华，典出谢道韫以柳絮喻雪。

examples.zh: 她从小就有咏絮之才，十岁便能作诗。
examples.en: She had a gift for poetry from an early age, and wrote verse at ten.

examples.zh: 这位女作家被誉为当代咏絮之才。
examples.en: This writer is praised as the talented poetess of our day.

story.en: On a snowy day Xie An asked his nephews what the snow was like; Xie Lang said 'like salt scattered in the air', but Daoyun said 'better, like willow catkins lifted by the wind', and he was delighted.
story.zh: 谢太傅寒雪日内集，问：“白雪纷纷何所似？”兄子胡儿曰：“撒盐空中差可拟。”兄女曰：“未若柳絮因风起。”

usage.en: Used to praise the literary gifts of women, typically in formal or literary writing.
usage.zh: 多用于称赞女子有才，常见于书面语。

natural: relieve generals of command over a cup of wine

meaning.en: Emperor Taizu of Song persuaded his generals over a banquet to give up their commands peacefully; removing power without bloodshed.
meaning.zh: 宋太祖在酒宴上劝石守信等将领交出兵权；指以温和手段解除权臣实权。

examples.zh: 老板请几位元老吃饭，杯酒释兵权，平稳完成了换届。
examples.en: The boss took the veterans out to dinner and eased the handover of power.

examples.zh: 历史上杯酒释兵权，避免了武将专权。
examples.en: In history, relieving the generals over wine prevented military strongmen.

usage.en: The event took place in AD 961 under Zhao Kuangyin, who also took power in a coup. Used for peaceful removal from office, sometimes ironically for a smooth purge.
usage.zh: 发生在宋初，赵匡胤本人也是兵变夺权。多指和平解除权力，有时带反讽。

story.en: In 961 Emperor Taizu of Song gave a banquet for Shi Shouxin and other generals and persuaded them to give up their commands for wealth and comfort. Li Tao's Xu Zizhi Tongjian Changbian records the event in volume 2.
story.zh: 宋太祖建隆二年设酒宴劝石守信等将领交出兵权、安享富贵；李焘《续资治通鉴长编》卷二有载。

natural: Sima Guang smashes the vat

meaning.en: Young Sima Guang saved a boy who fell into a water vat by smashing it with a stone; quick thinking in an emergency.
meaning.zh: 司马光小时候用石头砸破水缸，救出落水的小伙伴；比喻遇事机智冷静。

equivalents: break the vat to save a life

examples.zh: 孩子们学了司马光砸缸，知道遇到危险要冷静想办法。
examples.en: The children learned from Sima Guang that you need to think calmly in danger.

examples.zh: 面对突发状况，他来了个司马光砸缸，果断解决。
examples.en: Faced with an emergency, he did a Sima Guang and solved it decisively.

story.en: When Sima Guang was a child, a playmate fell into a huge vat; the others fled, but Guang took up a stone and broke the vat, so the water burst out and saved him.
story.zh: 群儿戏于庭，一儿登瓮，足跌没水中，众皆弃去，光持石击瓮破之，水迸，儿得活。

usage.en: A story every Chinese child knows, taught as a model of calm resourcefulness. Often used for 'break the container to save the contents'.
usage.zh: 中国孩子几乎人人都听过的故事，是临危不乱的榜样。

natural: filial piety that moves Heaven

meaning.en: Filial devotion so great that it moves even heaven; the story of Shun, whom elephants and birds helped farm.
meaning.zh: 孝心至诚，连上天都被感动；指虞舜以孝行感动天地的故事。

examples.zh: 他对母亲的照顾真是孝感动天。
examples.en: His care for his mother is filial devotion that would move heaven.

examples.zh: 老人讲起舜孝感动天的故事，孩子们听得入神。
examples.en: The old man told the story of Shun's piety moving heaven and the children listened spellbound.

story.en: Shun was mistreated by his father and stepmother but remained dutiful; elephants ploughed and birds weeded his fields on Mount Li, and Emperor Yao, hearing of him, gave him the empire.
story.zh: 舜遭父母、后母虐待，仍孝顺不改；在历山耕作，象来耕田，鸟来除草，尧闻其孝，将帝位传给他。

usage.en: Shun was ill-treated by his father and stepmother, yet stayed dutiful; at Mount Li elephants ploughed and birds weeded for him, so Emperor Yao gave him the throne. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 舜被父母和后母虐待，仍然孝顺；在历山耕种，象为他耕田，鸟为他除草，尧于是禅位于他。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: deer's milk for his parents

meaning.en: To go to extraordinary lengths to obtain what ageing parents need; Tanzi's dressing in deerskin to get deer milk for his blind parents.
meaning.zh: 为年迈的父母不惜一切；指郯子披鹿皮取鹿乳供养双目失明父母的故事。

equivalents: go to any lengths for one's parents

examples.zh: 他为照顾病母，几乎做到鹿乳奉亲的地步。
examples.en: He went almost as far as the deer-milk story to look after his sick mother.

examples.zh: 故事里，郯子鹿乳奉亲，连猎人也被感动。
examples.en: In the story, Tanzi fetched deer milk for his parents and even the hunter was moved.

story.en: Tanzi's blind parents craved deer milk, so he put on a deerskin and joined the herd to get it; when a hunter almost shot him, he revealed himself and told him why, and the hunter let him go.
story.zh: 郯子的双亲患眼疾，想喝鹿乳，他披鹿皮进入鹿群取乳；猎人欲射，他说明缘由，猎人便放了他。

usage.en: The story of Tanzi (郯子), who wore a deerskin to reach the herd and was nearly shot by a hunter before explaining himself. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 郯子披鹿皮混入鹿群取乳，险被猎人射中，说明缘由后猎人为之感动。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

literal: hundred · li · carry on back · rice
natural: carrying rice a hundred li

meaning.en: To work and travel far to feed one's parents; Zilu carried rice from a hundred li away.
meaning.zh: 不辞辛劳远道为父母背米；指子路为双亲负米百里的故事。

equivalents: go far to feed one's parents

examples.zh: 他放学后还要打工，真是百里负米。
examples.en: After school he still has to work part-time, a modern version of carrying rice a hundred li.

examples.zh: 子路百里负米的故事常被拿来教育孩子。
examples.en: Zilu's story of carrying rice a hundred li is often used to teach children.

story.en: Zilu was poor and ate wild vegetables, but walked a hundred li to carry rice home for his parents. After they died he became a rich official and sighed that he could no longer carry rice for them.
story.zh: 仲由家贫，自己吃野菜，却到百里之外为父母背米；父母去世后他位高俸厚，感叹再也不能为双亲负米了。

usage.en: About Zilu (仲由), a disciple of Confucius, who ate wild greens himself but walked a hundred li to carry rice home to his parents; later, rich, he regretted that they were no longer alive. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 子路是孔子弟子，家贫，自己吃野菜，却到百里外背米养亲；后来富贵了，父母已不在。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: a bitten finger and an aching heart

meaning.en: The bond between parent and child, so that one feels the other's call; Zengzi felt a heartache when his mother bit her finger.
meaning.zh: 亲子之间心灵相通；指曾参因母亲咬手指而心痛的故事。

equivalents: a mother's call felt in the heart

examples.zh: 母子连心，真是啮指痛心。
examples.en: Mother and son are so close that it's like the biting finger and aching heart.

story.en: When guests arrived while Zengzi was away gathering firewood, his mother bit her finger; Zengzi felt a stab in his heart and hurried home to ask what was wrong.
story.zh: 曾参上山打柴，家中来客，母亲咬自己的手指，曾参忽觉心痛，急忙背柴回家询问。

usage.en: Zengzi (曾参) was a disciple of Confucius. When guests came while he was out, his mother bit her finger, and he felt the pain in his heart and hurried home. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 曾参是孔子弟子，他外出时家中来客，母亲咬指，他心中一痛，便急忙赶回。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: the reed-lined coat that appeased his mother

meaning.en: To keep one's filial duty without resentment, even when treated unfairly; Min Sun's plea for his stepmother.
meaning.zh: 受到不公对待仍孝顺不怨；指闵损替后母求情的故事。

examples.zh: 他对后母没有怨言，真有芦衣顺母的气度。
examples.en: He bears his stepmother no grudge, with the spirit of the reed-coat story.

examples.zh: 书里讲了芦衣顺母的故事，劝人宽容。
examples.en: The book tells the story of the reed coat, urging tolerance.

story.en: Min Sun's stepmother lined his coat with reed catkins while her own sons had cotton; when his father found out and wanted to send her away, Min Sun begged him not to, saying that one cold son was better than three.
story.zh: 闵损的后母用芦花为他做冬衣，却给亲生儿子用棉絮；父亲发现后要休妻，闵损求情说：“母在一子单，母去三子寒。”

usage.en: Min Sun (闵损, Min Ziqian) was a disciple of Confucius; his stepmother lined his winter coat with reed catkins instead of cotton. When his father found out and wanted to divorce her, he begged for mercy. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 闵损是孔子弟子，后母用芦花给他做冬衣，父亲发现后要休妻，他跪求宽恕。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: tasting the medicine himself

meaning.en: To care for a sick parent personally, even tasting the medicine first; Emperor Wen of Han.
meaning.zh: 亲自照料病中的父母，连汤药也先尝；指汉文帝侍奉母亲的故事。

examples.zh: 母亲生病期间，他亲尝汤药，日夜守护。
examples.en: While his mother was ill, he tended her day and night and tasted her medicine himself.

examples.zh: 汉文帝亲尝汤药的故事流传千年。
examples.en: The tale of Emperor Wen tasting the medicine himself has lasted for a thousand years.

story.en: Emperor Wen of Han, though busy ruling, never took off his clothes during his mother's three-year illness and always tasted the medicine before she took it.
story.zh: 汉文帝刘恒虽日理万机，母亲生病三年，他衣不解带，汤药必先亲口尝过才奉上。

usage.en: Liu Heng, Emperor Wen of Han (r. 180–157 BC), nursed his mother Empress Dowager Bo for three years, not changing his clothes and tasting each medicine first. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 汉文帝刘恒侍奉母亲薄太后，三年间衣不解带，汤药必先尝。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: mulberries in separate baskets

meaning.en: To give one's parents the best; Cai Shun picked ripe black mulberries for his mother and kept the unripe red ones for himself.
meaning.zh: 把最好的留给父母；指蔡顺把熟的黑桑葚给母亲、生的红桑葚留给自己。

equivalents: separate the ripe fruit for mother

examples.zh: 他把最好的都留给妈妈，有拾葚异器的孝心。
examples.en: He keeps the best for his mother, with the spirit of the mulberry-picking story.

examples.zh: 拾葚异器的故事让赤眉军也感动了。
examples.en: The story of the mulberries in two baskets even moved the Red Eyebrows rebels.

story.en: In a famine Cai Shun picked mulberries in two vessels, ripe black ones for his mother and unripe red ones for himself; when the Red Eyebrows rebels asked why, they were moved and gave him rice and an ox leg.
story.zh: 饥荒之年，蔡顺拾桑葚分盛两器，黑熟者奉母，赤生者自食；赤眉军问其故，深受感动，赠他白米和牛蹄。

usage.en: Cai Shun lived in the Han dynasty famine; the bandit Red Eyebrows saw him picking mulberries in two vessels, were moved by his reason and gave him rice and an ox leg. 葚 reads shèn. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 蔡顺为汉代人，饥荒时拾桑葚分盛两器，赤眉军问明缘由，深为感动，赠米和牛蹄。“葚”读 shèn。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: burying his son to feed his mother

meaning.en: To sacrifice a child to feed one's mother; Guo Ju's story, now generally criticised as extreme.
meaning.zh: 为供养母亲而活埋亲子；郭巨的故事，今天多被批评为极端愚孝。

equivalents: sacrifice one's child for a parent

examples.zh: 埋儿奉母的做法现在看来太极端了。
examples.en: The act of burying a child to feed one's mother looks far too extreme now.

examples.zh: 鲁迅曾批评埋儿奉母这类“孝子”故事。
examples.en: Lu Xun criticised stories of 'dutiful sons' like the one about burying a son for his mother.

story.en: Guo Ju was so poor that his mother shared her food with his small son, so he decided to bury the child; while digging he found a pot of gold marked as a gift from Heaven.
story.zh: 郭巨家贫，母亲常把食物分给孙子，他决定埋掉儿子以养母；掘坑时得黄金一釜，上书“天赐孝子郭巨”。

usage.en: A negative example in modern discussion: Guo Ju, short of food, decided to bury his young son so his mother would not share her meals; he found a pot of gold. Often cited to criticise blind filial piety (愚孝). One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 现代多作反面例子，批评愚孝：郭巨家贫，欲埋儿省口粮供母，掘地得黄金一釜。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: selling himself to bury his father

meaning.en: To sell oneself into service in order to give a parent a proper burial; Dong Yong.
meaning.zh: 卖身为奴以安葬父亲；指董永的故事。

equivalents: sell oneself to bury one's father

examples.zh: 他像董永卖身葬父一样，为父亲治病倾尽所有。
examples.en: Like Dong Yong selling himself to bury his father, he spent everything on his father's treatment.

examples.zh: 戏里常演卖身葬父的情节，多是穷孩子的无奈。
examples.en: Operas often show a poor child selling himself to bury a parent.

story.en: Dong Yong was too poor to bury his father, so he sold himself as a servant to raise the money; on his way, a fairy girl appeared and became his wife, helping him to pay off his debt.
story.zh: 董永家贫，父亲去世无钱安葬，便卖身为奴筹款；途中有仙女与他结为夫妇，织锦助他还债。

usage.en: Later folklore adds that the Seventh Fairy, a heavenly weaver, married Dong Yong and wove cloth to buy back his freedom; this is the story of the opera 《天仙配》. In modern usage 卖身葬父 usually shows desperate poverty. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 民间传说说织女（七仙女）下凡与董永成亲，织锦为他赎身，即黄梅戏《天仙配》。今多形容穷苦无奈。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: carving wooden parents and serving them

meaning.en: To serve one's late parents as if they were still alive; Ding Lan's carved statues.
meaning.zh: 像侍奉在世父母一样侍奉亡亲；指丁兰刻木像的故事。

equivalents: serve a dead parent as if living

examples.zh: 他把父母的照片摆在桌上，每天问候，像是刻木事亲。
examples.en: He keeps his parents' photos on the table and greets them daily, like the carved-statue story.

examples.zh: 刻木事亲的故事也有人觉得迷信。
examples.en: Some think the story of serving carved parents is superstitious.

story.en: Ding Lan lost his parents young and carved wooden statues of them to serve every day as though they were alive; when his wife disrespected a statue, it was said to bleed.
story.zh: 丁兰早年丧亲，刻木为像，朝夕奉养如生；其妻对木像不敬，木像手指出血。

usage.en: Ding Lan (丁兰), orphaned young, carved wooden figures of his parents and served them daily; his wife once pricked a figure's finger and it bled. Sometimes read as a lesson in remembering parents, sometimes criticised as superstitious. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 丁兰幼年丧亲，刻木像奉养；其妻刺木像手指，指出血。有人视为怀念双亲，也有人认为迷信。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: a spring gushed forth and carp leaped

meaning.en: Filial devotion that is rewarded by a miracle; the spring and carp of Jiang Shi and his wife.
meaning.zh: 孝心感动上天，得到奇迹般的回报；指姜诗夫妇家中涌出泉水、鲤鱼跳出的故事。

equivalents: spring and carp for devoted parents

examples.zh: 他们夫妻侍奉老人几十年，真是涌泉跃鲤。
examples.en: The couple looked after the old folk for decades, like Jiang Shi and his wife with the spring and the carp.

examples.zh: 书上说涌泉跃鲤，其实是在赞扬孝顺。
examples.en: The book says a spring gushed forth and carp leaped, which in fact praises filial piety.

story.en: Jiang Shi's wife Pang walked six or seven li to fetch river water and fish for his mother; moved by their devotion, Heaven made a spring burst out by the house, from which a carp leaped every day.
story.zh: 姜诗的妻子庞氏每天走六七里去江边取水、买鱼奉养婆婆；孝心感动上天，宅旁涌出泉水，每日跃出鲤鱼。

usage.en: Jiang Shi's wife, Madam Pang, walked far to fetch river water and fish for her mother-in-law; a spring burst out beside the house and a pair of carp leaped from it each day. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 姜诗之妻庞氏远道取水、取鱼奉姑，后来住宅旁涌出泉水，每天跃出双鲤。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: hiring himself out to support his mother

meaning.en: To work for hire to support one's mother; Jiang Ge.
meaning.zh: 给人做工，以供养母亲；指江革的故事。

equivalents: work as a hired hand to feed one's mother

examples.zh: 他年纪轻轻就外出打工养母，称得上行佣供母。
examples.en: He went out to work for hire young to support his mother, like Jiang Ge.

examples.zh: 行佣供母的故事至今仍被用来讲孝道。
examples.en: The story of supporting his mother by hired labour is still told as an example of filial duty.

story.en: In the chaos of war Jiang Ge carried his mother on his back to flee; when bandits came he begged them to spare her, and afterwards he hired himself out as a labourer to support her.
story.zh: 乱世中江革背母逃难，遇盗贼哭求饶母；后来给人做工，供养母亲。

usage.en: Jiang Ge (江革) carried his mother on his back through bandits and war, then worked as a day-labourer to keep her. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 江革背着母亲逃难，遇盗贼哭求，后给人做工供养母亲。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: weeping at the grave when thunder sounds

meaning.en: Deep, lasting grief for a dead parent; Wang Pou, who hurried to his mother's grave at every thunderclap.
meaning.zh: 对亡母的深深思念；指王裒在雷声中跑到母亲墓前守护哭泣。

examples.zh: 每逢雷雨，他都想起母亲，有闻雷泣墓之思。
examples.en: In every thunderstorm he thinks of his mother, moved by the story of the weeping at the tomb.

examples.zh: 闻雷泣墓写的是儿子对母亲的深情。
examples.en: The story of weeping at the grave when thunder sounds shows a son's deep love for his mother.

story.en: Wang Pou's mother was afraid of thunder; after she died, whenever it thundered he ran to her grave, saying 'Pou is here, Mother, do not be afraid.'
story.zh: 王裒之母生前怕雷，去世后每逢雷雨，王裒便跑到墓前，说：“裒在此，母亲勿惧。”

usage.en: Wang Pou (王裒) of the Jin dynasty; his mother had feared thunder in life, so after she died he went to her grave every time it thundered and told her he was there. He later refused office under the Sima family out of loyalty to his father. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 晋代王裒，母亲生前怕雷，去世后每逢雷雨，他便到墓前哭泣，说“裒在此”。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

natural: weeping made the bamboo sprout

meaning.en: Sincere filial feeling that moves nature to respond; Meng Zong's winter bamboo shoots for his sick mother.
meaning.zh: 孝心至诚，感动天地；指孟宗在冬天为病母哭出竹笋的故事。

examples.zh: 故事里孟宗哭竹生笋，孩子们听了都很感动。
examples.en: In the story Meng Zong's tears made bamboo shoots grow, and the children were moved.

examples.zh: 她为了给母亲治病四处奔走，真有哭竹生笋的诚意。
examples.en: She ran around everywhere for her mother's treatment, with Meng Zong's sincerity.

story.en: Meng Zong's sick mother wanted bamboo-shoot soup in winter, when none grew; he went into the bamboo grove and wept, and shoots pushed up through the ground.
story.zh: 孟宗之母病重，冬天想喝竹笋汤，他到竹林里哭泣，地上忽然长出数茎竹笋。

usage.en: Meng Zong (孟宗) was a Three Kingdoms-period figure; his sick mother craved bamboo-shoot soup in winter, and when he wept in the bamboo grove, shoots sprang up. Also called 孟宗哭竹. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 三国时的孟宗，母亲病中想喝笋汤，冬天无笋，他在竹林痛哭，笋破土而出。又称“孟宗哭竹”。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。

literal: seize by the throat · tiger · save · father
natural: gripping the tiger to save his father

meaning.en: To risk one's life to save one's father; Yang Xiang, aged fourteen, grappled a tiger.
meaning.zh: 冒着生命危险救父亲；指杨香十四岁时扼住老虎的故事。

equivalents: risk one's life for one's father
fight a tiger for a parent

examples.zh: 为了救父亲，他毫不犹豫，真有扼虎救父的勇气。
examples.en: He did not hesitate to save his father, with the courage of the tiger-gripping story.

examples.zh: 扼虎救父的故事如今更多当作勇敢的象征。
examples.en: Today the story of gripping the tiger is more a symbol of courage.

story.en: Yang Xiang, fourteen, went into the hills with her father when a tiger sprang at him; she leapt on the tiger and held its throat so that it let him go.
story.zh: 杨香十四岁，随父亲入山割稻，忽遇猛虎扑向父亲，她跳上去扼住虎颈，老虎遂放开父亲。

usage.en: Yang Xiang (杨香), a girl of fourteen, was with her father when a tiger attacked; she leapt onto its neck and the tiger fled. 扼 reads è. One of the Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars (《二十四孝》), a Yuan-dynasty collection by Guo Jujing; today the stories are seen as moral tales, and some of the more extreme ones are no longer held up as models.
usage.zh: 杨香十四岁，随父入山遇虎，她跳上虎颈，老虎退走。“扼”读 è。出自元代郭居敬所编《二十四孝》；今天多当作道德故事看待，其中较极端的做法已不再被奉为榜样。
